### TLDR [...] Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across various natural language processing tasks. Serving LLM inference for generating long contents, however, poses a challenge due to the enormous memory footprint of the transient state, known as the key-value (KV) cache, which scales with the sequence length and batch size. In this paper, we present InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework tailored for long-text generation, which synergistically works [...] ### TLDR

InfiniGen is presented, a novel KV cache management framework tailored for long-text generation, which synergistically works with modern offloading-based inference systems and improves the overall performance of a modern offloading-based system by up to 3.00x compared to prior KV cache management methods while offering substantially better model accuracy.

results.title: KV Cache Management
results.content:
InfiniGen takes a novel approach to KV cache management by selectively maintaining only the most important token representations in the cache. The key insight is that not all tokens contribute equally to the generation process.

### Key Principles

1.   Selective Token Retention: Instead of storing the KV pairs for all tokens, InfiniGen identifies and retains only those that are most important for accurate generation. [...] Menu

# KV Cache Management

Relevant source files
   README.md

This document details the dynamic Key-Value (KV) Cache Management system in InfiniGen, which is a core component responsible for reducing memory footprint during LLM inference while maintaining model performance. The KV Cache Management works in conjunction with the Token Speculation Mechanism that identifies important tokens and the Prefetching System that retrieves essential KV cache entries. [...] InfiniGen's KV Cache Management system is designed to work with various LLM architectures including OPT, Llama, and GPT-NeoX. The integration is achieved through:

1.   Model-Specific Adapters: Interface between the model's attention mechanism and the KV Cache Manager.
2.   Modified Attention Implementation: Customized attention calculation that works with selective KV caching.
3.   Layer Integration: Hooks into the model's forward pass to intercept and modify the data flow.
